en-us.shower_bather_expel_question: The shower is still running. $doer.firstname$ asks whether $bather.firstname$ wants to push out what's inside, too.
en-us.shower_expel_mouth: Under the water, $bather.firstname$ spits out what was in the mouth and rinses. $deflateMsg1$.
en-us.shower_expel_womb: $bather.firstname$ presses on the lower belly; what the womb can't hold runs out with the water. $deflateMsg2$.
en-us.shower_expel_vagina: $bather.firstname$ spreads their legs and flushes the vagina clean with warm water. $deflateMsg3$.
en-us.shower_expel_anus: $bather.firstname$ squats and relaxes, letting what had pooled inside wash away. $deflateMsg4$.
en-us.shower_expel_rest: $bather.firstname$ pushes out whatever else the body couldn't hold. $deflateMsg5$.
en-us.shower_self_rinse_changed: $bather.firstname$ washes off the residue on the body ($showerWashReport$), then rinses carefully.
en-us.shower_assisted_rinse_changed: $doer.firstname$ helps wash the residue off $bather.firstname$ ($showerWashReport$), then rinses carefully.
